  const buf = await r.arrayBuffer();

  const ws = wb.Sheets[wb.SheetNames[0]];

  const h = rows[hdrIdx];
  const wcol = h.findIndex(c => /Withdrawals/i.test(String(c)));

  for (let i = hdrIdx + 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
    const lab = String(rows[i][0]).replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
    if (!lab) continue;
    const v = [num(rows[i][wcol]), num(rows[i][wcol+1]), num(rows[i][fcol]), num(rows[i][fcol+1])];

    if (/^All taxpayers/i.test(lab)) key = 'all';
    else if (/^No age/i.test(lab)) key = 'noage';
    else if (/^(Under 15|Under 20|15 under 20|20 under 25|25 under 30|30 under 35|35 under 40|40 under 45|45 under 50|50 under 55|55 under 60)$/i.test(lab)) key = 'u60';
    else if (/^60 under 65$/i.test(lab)) key = 'a6064';
    else if (/^65 under 70$/i.test(lab)) key = 'a6569';
    else if (/^70 under 75$/i.test(lab)) key = 'a7074';
    else if (/^75 under 80$/i.test(lab)) key = 'a7579';
    else if (/^80 and over$/i.test(lab)) key = 'a80';
    else if (/^(\[|\*|Note|Source|n\.a|N\/A)/i.test(lab)) break;
    if (key) for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) g[key][k] += (v[k] || 0);
  }

}
